items.definition:
of a kind previously mentioned; to such a degree
It was such a beautiful day.

certain; confident
Are you sure about that?

not costing anything; not restricted
This concert is free.

a small number of
I have a few friends coming over.

actual; genuine
Is that a real diamond?

not the same
These two shirts are very different.

relating to people in general
The park is open to the public.

as much as needed
Do we have enough time?

difficult; firm
This test is very hard.

far
The store is not far from here.

kind
She is a very kind person.

more than two but not many
I have several books to read.

able to be done or achieved
Is it possible to finish this today?

better, greater, or different from what is usual
This is a very special occasion.

last, ultimate
This is the final decision.

easy to understand, transparent
The sky is clear today.

principal, most important
What is the main idea?

strong
He is a very strong man.

usual; shared
It's common to see tourists here in summer.

private; individual
Please keep your personal belongings safe.

not alive
The plant is dead because I forgot to water it.

connected to the internet
I bought the tickets online.

center; intermediate
He lives in the middle of the city.

here; current
All students were present for the lesson.

without other people
She likes to be alone sometimes.

sure; confident
Are you certain about your decision?

circular, spherical
The table is round.

causing great wonder or surprise
The view from the mountain was amazing.

serious
This is a serious problem.

poor
The family was very poor.

relating to Europe or its people
She is a European citizen.

excellent, very good
That was a super idea!

insane, wild
That's a crazy idea, but it might work!

happening every day
I read the daily newspaper.

contemporary, new
I prefer modern art to classical art.

well-liked
This song is very popular right now.

secure, not in danger
It's not safe to walk alone at night.

enormous, very big
They live in a huge house.

extending far down from the top or surface
The lake is very deep in the middle.

not curved or bent
Draw a straight line.

causing laughter or amusement
That movie was really funny.

twice as much or as many
I ordered a double espresso.

usual or ordinary
It's normal to feel nervous before a test.

arousing curiosity or interest
That was a very interesting book.

added to an existing or usual amount or number
Do you want an extra slice of cake?

fast, rapid
She made a quick decision.

preferred above all others
What's your favorite color?

of great weight
This box is very heavy.

broad, extensive
The river is very wide at this point.

interested
Are you interested in learning a new language?

lacking intelligence or common sense
It was a stupid mistake to make.

engaging or ready to engage in physically energetic pursuits
She leads a very active lifestyle.

relating to Australia or its people
My friend is Australian.

kept hidden from others
They shared a secret handshake.

having a lot of money or possessions
He became rich after starting his own business.

having the pleasant taste characteristic of sugar or honey
This cake is very sweet.

happy, pleased
I'm glad to hear that.

fundamental, essential
He has a basic understanding of the subject.

masculine, relating to men
The survey asked for the respondent's male or female status.

in or characteristic of the north
We traveled to the northern part of the country.

extremely good or pleasing
We had a wonderful time at the party.

known by many people
He is a famous actor.

having four equal straight sides and four right angles
The table has a square top.

not previously known or used; newly made or acquired
I love the smell of fresh bread.
